instruction: How to train AI model in LLM Forge?
output: 3 easy steps: 1. Choose model like Qwen 0.5B in Maker tab 2. Add data - click Use Sample Data button in Data tab 3. Train tab - click TRAIN MY AI NOW! Wait 5 mins - Done! Your AI ready to chat!

QLoRA is efficient fine-tuning method that uses 4-bit quantization to save 93% VRAM! Example: 7B model needs 28GB normally, but with QLoRA needs only 6GB! So you can train 7B on 8GB VRAM like Colab Free T4!

Packing packs multiple short examples into one long sequence instead of padding with zeros (wastes 50%). Benefit: 2x faster training, 100% data used, 0% lost! Always enable packing for minimal data loss!

DoRA is Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation - better LoRA, +2-3% quality! NEFTune adds noise to embeddings - +2% quality for small data and prevents overfitting! Both checked by default in LLM Forge - free quality boost!

instruction: How to use model with Ollama?
output: After training in LLM Forge: 1. Export tab - check GGUF Q4_K_M + Ollama - Export 2. Install Ollama: curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh 3. Create: ollama create my-ai -f ./exports/Modelfile 4. Run: ollama run my-ai -> Chat with your AI locally, private, fast!

Overfitting is when AI memorizes training data but fails on new data. Example: Train loss goes down (4.0->0.8) but val loss goes up (3.8->5.0) = Overfitting! Fix: More data, fewer epochs, lower learning rate, enable NEFTune.

instruction: How to avoid data loss in training?
output: Minimal data loss tips: 1. Enable Packing - 100% utilization vs 50% padded 2. Lossless tokenization - no data lost 3. Checkpoint every 50 steps - never lose progress 4. Mount Drive in Colab to save checkpoints to Drive!

instruction: What is fine-tuning vs from scratch?
output: Fine-tuning: Take existing AI like Qwen 0.5B (already knows a lot) and teach it your data - Fast (5 mins), needs little data (6 examples), best quality! From scratch: Create brand new AI from zero with only your data - Slow (hours/days), needs more data (100+), for learning how LLMs work!
